result.instructions: Tools for Coursebox, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Create a draft course called Intro to Bookkeeping with 3 modules and 2 lessons in each."; "Show the sections and lessons of my course."; "Write the first lesson for new small-business owners and add a 5-question quiz.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Coursebox data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run coursebox_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run coursebox_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run coursebox_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. coursebox_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: coursebox_get_course_structure
tools.title: Get course structure
tools.description: Read the sections (blocks) of a course, each with its lessons (activities), in order. Use it to find section and lesson ids. API: GET /api/Blocks with a filter on courseId.

course_id.description: Course id (the id returned by Coursebox).

tools.name: coursebox_create_course
tools.title: Create course
tools.description: WRITE. Create an empty draft course and return it with its id. The key's user becomes owner and admin. Counts toward the plan's course limit (over the limit the call fails with 403). API: POST /api/Courses/createCourse.

description.description: Short description shown on the course page.

gradingMethod.description: How completion is graded, e.g. completion.

searchable.description: Show the course in the catalogue once published.

enrollmentEmail.description: Email learners when they are enrolled.

avatarUrl.description: Public URL of the course image.

backgroundUrl.description: Public URL of the banner image.

skills.description: Skills shown on the landing page.

tools.name: coursebox_update_course
tools.title: Update course details
tools.description: WRITE. Change course details. Only the fields you send change. Editing a published course goes live at once. API: POST /api/Courses/updateAttributes.

course_id.description: Course id (the id returned by Coursebox).

description.description: Short description shown on the course page.

gradingMethod.description: How completion is graded, e.g. completion.

searchable.description: Show the course in the catalogue once published.

enrollmentEmail.description: Email learners when they are enrolled.

avatarUrl.description: Public URL of the course image.

backgroundUrl.description: Public URL of the banner image.

skills.description: Skills shown on the landing page.

tools.name: coursebox_create_section
tools.title: Create section
tools.description: WRITE. Add a section (module) to a course and return its id. Create sections in order: position 0, 1, 2. API: POST /api/Courses/{courseId}/blocks.

course_id.description: Course id (the id returned by Coursebox).

position.description: Place in the course, starting at 0.

tools.name: coursebox_rename_section
tools.title: Rename section
tools.description: WRITE. Rename a section (module). API: PATCH /api/Blocks/{sectionId}.

section_id.description: Section id (the id returned by Coursebox).

tools.name: coursebox_delete_section
tools.title: Delete section
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE. Delete a section and all of its lessons. This cannot be undone. API: DELETE /api/Blocks/{sectionId}.

section_id.description: Section id (the id returned by Coursebox).

tools.name: coursebox_create_lesson
tools.title: Create lesson
tools.description: WRITE. Add an empty lesson to the end of a section and return its id. Fill it afterwards with coursebox_edit_lesson_with_ai. API: POST /api/Blocks/createActivity.

section_id.description: Section id (the id returned by Coursebox).

tools.name: coursebox_move_lesson
tools.title: Move lesson
tools.description: WRITE. Move a lesson to a position inside its section (0 = first). API: POST /api/Blocks/{sectionId}/activity-position.

section_id.description: Section id that holds the lesson (the id returned by Coursebox).

lesson_id.description: Lesson id (the id returned by Coursebox).

tools.name: coursebox_delete_lesson
tools.title: Delete lesson
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE. Delete a lesson with its content, quiz and assignment. This cannot be undone. API: POST /api/Activities/deleteActivity.

lesson_id.description: Lesson id (the id returned by Coursebox).

tools.name: coursebox_edit_lesson_with_ai
tools.title: Edit lesson with AI
tools.description: WRITE (AI, not idempotent). Fill or change ONE lesson from a plain-language instruction. Coursebox's own AI writes text, layouts, images, video, translations, quizzes and assignments, and saves them. Send one lesson per call and put any exact text or exact quiz questions in the message. Check assistantMessage: the AI may ask a question. A call can take up to 5 minutes. Limit: 30 requests per minute per user. API: POST /api/Activities/editPageContentAgentic.

lesson_id.description: Lesson id (the id returned by Coursebox).

message.description: The instruction in plain language, at most 8 KB (UTF-8 bytes).

deep_edit.description: true (default): the AI may take up to 30 steps. false: a quicker, lighter pass.

tools.name: coursebox_publish_course
tools.title: Publish course
tools.description: WRITE. Publish a draft course. join_status "public" lets anyone on the portal join. "private" lets learners join only when enrolled or invited. Edits after publishing go live at once. Coursebox emails the course owner a confirmation. API: POST /api/Courses/publish.

course_id.description: Course id (the id returned by Coursebox).

tools.name: coursebox_unpublish_course
tools.title: Unpublish course
tools.description: WRITE. Return a published course to draft, so learners cannot see it. API: POST /api/Courses/unpublish.

course_id.description: Course id (the id returned by Coursebox).
